📝 What does this PR do?
A short summary of the change, one or two sentences.

🎯 Why?
The reason for the change, or a link to the issue/task, e.g. Closes #12 

🔖 Type of change
[ ] ✨ New feature
[ ] 🐛 Bug fix
[ ] ♻️ Refactoring (no change in behavior)
[ ] 📚 Documentation or other

🧪 How was it tested?
For example: ran the app, added an item, removed an item, checked the JSON file.

✅ Checklist
[ ] 🔨 The project builds (dotnet build)
[ ] ▶️ The app starts and I tried the changed part manually
[ ] 🚦 The dotnet-check workflow is green
[ ] 🧹 No leftover debug code or commented-out code
[ ] 💾 JSON data files are updated if the data structure changed

📸 Screenshots (optional)
Paste a screenshot of the console output if the UI changed.

🙏 Thanks for contributing!
